verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents one package manager across macOS, Linux and Windows. The shared config is a Brewfile that sets up project dependencies 'across these environments' with one command. Windows support is only through WSL, not native Windows, and some Brewfile entry types are platform-specific (Mac App Store, WinGet on WSL). Missing for 10: native (non-WSL) Windows support, documentation of how one Brewfile behaves portably across OSes, and independent hands-on corroboration of identical workflows across all three platforms.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the same workflow and config on macOS, Linux, and Windows
